01 / THE SETTING

Not every IT problem
stays behind a desk.

At the University of Notre Dame, I supported dining technology and a fleet of approximately 20 delivery robots.

My work combined support tickets, hands-on maintenance, and coordination with the people keeping campus services running.

Fix the technology.
Help the person.

Working with internal teams and vendors taught me that technical support is also about clear communication and follow-through.

“The job isn't only to understand the system. It's to help the people relying on it.”
